title: Integration of multiple expression cassettes into mammalian genomes in a single step
protocol: Use Phusion high-fidelity DNA polymerase in 2× HF buffer for PCR.
Reduce non-specific amplification during PCR by using wax beads.
Transform competent E. coli cells with 0.5 μl of ligation or restriction free reaction.
Select transformed cells on LB agar plates containing the appropriate antibiotic.
Incubate LB agar plates overnight at 37°C.
Pick 2-10 white colonies and inoculate small scale cultures in LB media containing the appropriate antibiotic.
Analyze isolated plasmids by restriction mapping using restriction enzymes.
Verify the inserted gene by sequencing.
Set up plasmid assembly reactions for 3 MultiLabel vectors in a 10 μl volume.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 1 hour at 37°C.
Use 0.5 μl of the Cre recombinase reaction to transform competent E. coli cells.
Plate the cells on LB agar plates containing appropriate antibiotics.
Incubate overnight at 30°C.
Pick 2-10 colonies to grow small scale cultures for plasmid isolation in LB media with corresponding antibiotics.
Analyze isolated plasmids by restriction mapping using appropriate enzymes.
Set up preparative restriction digestion reaction in a 50 μl volume: Add 50 μg of MultiLabel multigene vector, 5 μl of 10× digestion buffer (Tango), and 1 μl of I-SceI restriction enzyme.
Incubate for 16 hours at 37°C.
Run an analytic agarose gel to check if the multigene vector is linearized completely.
Purify the linearized multigene plasmid using the QIAprep PCR purification kit or phenol-chloroform extraction followed by ethanol precipitation.
Measure the concentration of the linearized multigene plasmid.
Plate HEK293 or PAE cells 6-9 hours prior to transfection in 10cm dishes.
Ensure cells are 30-40% confluent before transfecting.
Mix 5 μg of linearized multigene plasmid with 7.5 μl FuGENE HD transfection reagent in 250 μl serum-free medium (Opti-MEM I).
Incubate the mixture for 20 min at room temperature.
Add the mixture to the plated cells.
Pass cells into 2-4 10 cm plates 40 hours after transfection at different dilutions (1:2, 1:5, and 1:20).
Add selection drug one day after replating.
Replace medium once or twice per week, always adding the drug.
Observe colonies within 14-21 days.
Pick colonies using clone rings with grease for PAE cells or filter cloning discs (Sigma) for HEK293 cells.
Transfer picked colonies to 1 cm wells and grow in the presence of selection drug.
Pass cells into 3.5 or 6 cm plates.
Freeze cell aliquots.
